description: Los Angeles International Airport (LAX) - Parking Lots Current Status is a dataset listed in City of Los Angeles open data portal (data.lacity.org), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Los Angeles. Displays parking information capacity live. Information on Parking lots; 1, 2A, 2B, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, C. Data is updated every five minutes. Coverage: Los Angeles. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are parking realtime status lax lawa airport. The table has 12 columns. Attribution on the portal: Los Angeles World Airports. The portal shows 2024-05-02 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-lacity-org-portal.
